items.title: How uneven can a scope profile be?
items.description: This is a teaching model, not a promotion formula. Each scope dimension from L1 can be narrow (1) or wide (10). Drag influence radius and compare it with the other dimensions to see why leveling is a profile of evidence, not one magic average.
items.compute: const avg = (params.ambiguityTolerance + params.blastRadius + params.timeHorizon + params.influenceRadius) / 4; const scopeProfileAverage = Math.round(avg * 10) / 10; const influenceGap = Math.round((params.influenceRadius - avg) * 10) / 10; return { ambiguityTolerance: params.ambiguityTolerance, blastRadius: params.blastRadius, timeHorizon: params.timeHorizon, influenceRadius: params.influenceRadius, scopeProfileAverage, influenceGap };
